$comment: The ONE list of what `npx vantage-vscode-extension-boilerplate <dir>` puts in a new project. bin/create.mjs copies exactly these paths; bin/template-prepare.mjs renders .npmignore (the npm tarball allowlist) from them. `npm run test:pack` proves the list complete: a project created from the packed tarball installs, builds, tests, lints and packages a .vsix. `exclude` removes boilerplate-only files inside a listed directory. `generated` maps a tarball path written at prepack to the project path it is restored to (npm never ships a .gitignore nor a package-lock.json under their own names).
